name: ghostfolio
notes: Nx monorepo. The Angular client is apps/client and imports libraries from libs/. No angular.json, so ngp gets the tsconfig and --root.
installNotes: --min-release-age=0 overrides the repo's .npmrc (min-release-age=3): the pinned Angular prerelease is newer than three days. The lockfile keeps every other dependency where it was.
